items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: I think my harmony teacher's name was Scott.

ctx.x: Do you remember any of your instructors there?

I think my harmony teacher's name was Scott. I don't remember the piano player's, teacher's name and I don't remember the self-teaching and sight singing teacher's name. It was right across the hall from the harmony and theory. In fact, I was in sort of a maze at that particular time. A dream world, you know.
